Greetings support team,
Pet comfort came up after departure, so just a quick note. I want us to keep the focus on the traveler and the animal here, because this sounds like a case where a calm follow-up will make a real difference. Please treat the file as sensitive and keep the handoff tight so nobody is left guessing about next steps.

The passenger said the journey felt manageable at first, then the pet started showing signs of stress after the handoff, and that is exactly the kind of thing we need to catch early. <<FACT F060>> I am asking the team to review the booking notes, the kennel check, and the customer contact log together so we can see whether anything was missed during the changeover. If there is any gap in the animal care notes, flag it right away and loop in the senior coordinator before the story gets muddled.

I also want someone to confirm the pet's eligibility details against the travel guidance, because we cannot afford a loose interpretation when a small animal is involved. <<FACT F074>> Please keep the tone reassuring if you reach back to the traveler, and make it clear that Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk are taking this seriously. If Naomi Muller or Hana Moretti are already on this, coordinate with them directly and avoid sending mixed messages.

Let's stay steady, act quickly, and make sure the next update is clear and supportive for the passenger. Companion Animal Travel Desk
